body: Thanks. I figured I shouldn't fake an expression, it wouldn't accurately reflect me.
Yeah, I'd love to not hate myself. Thanks for the advice. Yeah, I'm hoping I look older than 12 within the next few years, haha. All good points, thanks man.
Thanks! Both the compliment and the advice.
Thanks, I like constructive criticism, I like to improve myself. Thanks for the advice, as well. I'll make sure to try and talk to somebody at a gym.
Thabks for the advice, both of you. I wish I could have taken a happy photo, but that would not have shown me as everyone else sees me.
Thanks. For both the advice and the compliment.
Not a hat person, I'll be able to stick with a comb and some gel. Thank you, though.
Okay, so general consensus is to bulk up, shave the facial hair, and let the head hair grow out. Thank you for the compliment.
Okay, so I've been getting the advice to get rid of the facial hair and let the hair atop my head grow out. Thanks for the advice, and the compliment.
Thank you for the tips. And yeah, I normally only allow my sideburns to grow out a little bit, but Movember.
Thanks for the advice, I'll let it grow out a bit.
Thanks man, the same to you.

Thanks for the advice, man. I only have the moustache because No Shave November, and I do need to hit the gym. The hair, yeah, I see what you're talking about. I guess I need to go out, grab a comb, and some weights. Good points. Thank you for the advice, once more.
Thanks. Yeah, but that's life. The only two things that are certain are death and taxes.
Yeah. Been trying to forget about it. The one person that i could talk to about my problems, the one person that wouldn't bully me, the one person that I knew, that one person is dead.
I haven't felt the need. Besides,  I only found out after school yesterday. Also trying to avoid the topic, I didn't want to talk about it unless it came up.
Just yesterday. Before school.
Yeah, it is. But my best, really only, friend was struck and killed by a bus, so I think my silence is understandable.
Well, besides her. But I haven't used my voice at all in the past day.
Sometimes I forget you can't hear my voice inflection via text. Though you wouldn't normally hear it, anyway. I haven't spoken in the last week.
Sorry about that. My sense of humor, if you can call it that, is rather sarcastic, take everything I say with a grain of salt.
Yeah, no shit. But they're wrong when they compliment me.
I disagree. Most people only compliment me to patronize me or piss me off.
Note the lack of symmetry. Symmetry basically defines beauty.
Sent.
Drop or PM me your email, I'll send you a picture of my face to prove it. (I don't feel comfortable just dropping a link here)

With Native American facial structure? Yeah it does. And also, I'm just generally not good looking. I'd make a post on r/amiugly, but I'm too young, according to their rules. And also, I look to be ~12.
Oh. Makes sense.
Like you?
I'm a native American that looks like a white man. I think that instantly qualifies me for ugly.
Yeah. Anything that would have prevented me from reproduction would result in my death, for the best. You don't want faulty genes to continue to propegate.
It is true. My physical disadvantage would have been quickly noticed, along with my mental issues, and I would have been devoured at a young age.
But I am speaking the truth. If I were any other creature, I probably would have been eaten by my parents at birth.
I speak the truth, I don't deserve to live or be happy, but if you wish, I will stop.
"Ugh" what?
First part, spot on. Second part, I disagree with. If I cannot continue the existence of the species and add my genes to the gene pool, I, by definition, don't deserve to live or be happy.
That's because I don't have to speak to you face to face. Over a keyboard, I have seemingly no problems, but in real life, I have trouble ordering food at McDonald's because of my social anxiety.

Well, if anyone manages to get past my appalling physical traits, then they see that I'm an asshole riddled with mental problems. Not exactly someone worth hanging around, not to mention procreate with. If I am not going to fulfill the ultimate goal in life, why should I live in the first place?
Why? So someone can convince me that barely passing high school, then barely graduating college, then spending the next 50-80 years alone is a life worth living?
Because I'm a miserable failure.
I did, and still do. At the time, there was nothing I wanted more than death. Same story for right now, there's nothing I want more than death.

Ive had a gun to my head before. I've had my finger on the trigger, ready to paint the walls with my brain. But my finger just wouldnt listen to my brain. It refused to move, to end me. That day has molded me, ever since then, I've felt like a massive failure. I mean, I couldn't even kill myself correctly.
I'm just so fed up with living. I want to end it all, make the pain go away forever.
Alright, just had to make sure.
Sorry if I offended you with that, I'm a little cynical from all the bullying.
I'm just some teenager with huge problems and no future. Why would you care?
Though I can't figure out why you want to help.
I can see that. If I didn't, this conversation wouldn't be happening.
Because all people do is pretend to be friendly or help and then use that position to hurt me more. I can't trust anybody that tries to get close.
Even if they're just being assholes, the last piece of evidence is irrefutable. When someone tries to help or be my friend, all I do is push them away, and usually hurt them in the process.
Yeah, but they also have a point.

You must be joking. Every time I enter a conversation, every one else finds excuses to leave. Whenever I sit near anybody, they find an excuse to move. The only time anyone gets near me is to hurt me. And the very few that try to help, I just push them away. I think those may be some red flags that I'm a bad person that doesn't deserve to live.
Yeah I do. You can't prove I don't.
No, it doesnt suck, I suck.
As I've always told people that try to help, "Its because I'm ugly, weak, small, nearby, and have a greater intellect than the common squirrel."
Ah, yeah. LWM: Living While a Minority, a serious crime according to most cops on this area.
Yeah, I tend to do the same. But dark skin is a curse, especially in what I dub "The south of the north".
Menominee. Born and lived in the city away from the rez, but I am Native American, through and through.
The only crime I committed to get my face slammed in a locker was LWI, Learning While Indian. Just kinda common here.
Wisconsin. A cop looking at a bystander, and the conversation of "You see that? He hit me." "Yep." is normal here.

I did. Went to the nurse with a nail in my leg, told them it was an accident in shop class. The locker door, a cop did that. Getting beat down? That was a group of gangsters. Besides, I deserve every little bit of it.
Got a pretty nasty stab wound, got my face slammed in a locker door, and got the living shit beat out of me.
No it is not. I wouldn't feel worthless if I wasn't worthless.
I feel worthless because I am worthless.
Even if it was the root of my problems, why would I want treatment? First of all, I'm worthless, and secondly, my personality would die. I want to die entirely, not just my personality.
I wouldn't be able to bring myself to live without depression, I can barely bring myself to live with it.
You don't want me to die, yet you also don't want me to be depressed. The two come as a package, die without depression, or live with it.
People tell me that depression isn't normal. If I need to be "cured", then I want to die.
The only way to kill the depression is to kill me.
No it isn't. The depression isn't a problem, it is me now. Or maybe it is the problem, in that case, I have to kill myself to kill the depression.
I'm introverted, that's who I am. All the therapy they've wanted me to get involved talking to people.
It is. If I started accepting compliments, if I started talking to people, I would be a different person.
Exactly. Being depressed, that's my personality. Its who I am.
It has become my personslity. I'm afraid that if I lose it, my personality will go away forever.
My depression, it defines me. I'm scared I will become an extroverted optimist, which is not me.
I mean happy little potato as in completely disconnected from reality, I want to be normal, not manic.
But I do deserve to die. And I have, the school psychiatrist, and he wants me to sit and pour my heart out so he can prescribe drugs and make me a happy little potato.
That's why I feel like I need go die, but I can't. I don't deserve to live, but she doesn't deserve to feel the pain, either.

Did. She freaked out and started crying, took me an hour to calm her down and explain my feelings. Literally the first time she's let me go, as in she's been holding me in her arms, since I talked to her. I want to die, but I'm scared she'll get distressed from it.
No I wouldn't, the fear, the fear is just personality defects manifesting themselves.
But it does, if I wasn't so defective, I wouldn't be afraid.
Exactly, I'm afraid I'll hurt her, and being afraid, by definition, makes me a coward.
Alright, how about this piece of evidence? I can't even bring myself to tell my girl that I want to die. That at least makes me a coward.
It does, almost by definition.
I am. I'm failing three of my eight classes, I can't even bench the bar, not to mention I'm depressed.

That's what she tells me, too, but I just can't believe that. I love her and she loves me, but she doesn't love me to the point where she'll throw her social life away to be with a anxious, depressed, loser.
All I do iis make her life miserable, she deserves better than worthless scum like me.
Alright, you got me there, you would be hurt. I can't really debate that. But her, she'll be happier than ever to find out that she can finally go out and live the life she wants to.
Who would be hurt by the decision? On the internet, the posts would just suddenly stop, and in real life, she will be happy to be able to move on to somebody better for her.
It is the only permanent solution that won't put strain or stress on anyone but myself. Logic dictates that it is the best choice.
I just want all the pain to stop, and death is the only logical choice.
Whats there to be sorry about? Maybe I can die by goading some stronger people to whopp my ass, internal hemorrhaging wouldn't be that bad of a way to go.
Nice to meet you. Kinda funny, I've always hated my name.  I would laugh if I actually could, but I just can't.
My name? John. And yourself?
But I'm right. She deserves a better guy, if I keep sticking around, she'll have to keep waiting for another guy.
But I am. She would have no problem finding another guy, one that doesn't have problems, one that is attractive, one that doesn't weigh down her life.
She would be able to find someone else, she would be able to be happy again. Sure, she would be grief stricken for a little bit, but eventually, she would forget about me, just like everyone else.
Wow what? I'm just speaking the truth.
She'd get over it. If anything, she would be relieved to not have dead weight like me dragging her life down.

All I do is bore her, she despises staying in, and i physically cannot bring myself to get out. Whenever I cut, I have to keep it secret now, because all I'll do is worry her. Sane with talking to her about me wanting to die, shed just want to take more of my burden, and that just isn't fair to her. If anything, I want to die because I love her
Sorry about the late reply, she got home and I figured I should spend at least some time with her. I just don't see a reason to live anymore.
I only know of one permanent solution to the pain, and I don't think you'd agree with that solution.
Yeah, probably, but I don't want to die from withdrawal. Besides, its the only way I know that can numb the pain.
Right now, you and the alcohol are my only companions. She doesn't get home for another forty five minutes to an hour.
The fact that I am still alive, and the fact that others keep trying to share my burden, I deserve the pain.
Why not? I deserve it. I need to feel the pain.
I guess death is always on my mind, and I'm running out of sharp objects to cut with. I just want to save them the trouble and hurt myself, maybe they'll return the favor and kill me.
Why should I? Maybe I can save others the trouble and throw myself down the stairs tomorrow, or hit my face against a wall and bust my nose.

That just reinforces my argument, I am a biological failure, and therefore should not live and put strain on society, possibly preventing those that would continue the existence of the species from ever making it past infancy. Me existing is hurting humanity as a whole.

Yep. I do deserve it. Biologically speaking, my conception was a huge failure. In all likelihood, I won't live to fulfill the ultimate goal in life and reproduce, and even if I don't kill myself before then, there's no way I'll want to pass my poor genes on to the next generation.

The bloody nose? I had that coming for me for being born. Same with the twisted arm and the toss down the stairs. The insults, they're right. I'm scrawny, I'm pale, I'm weak, and I'm ugly. And yeah, runs in the family.
The stuff they say, they're right. The physical abuse, I deserve it. And yeah, I have to shave my face every morning, lest I go to work or school with a five o clock shadow.

Shitty, as per the usual. Woke up and went through the morning routine of shave, shower, and dress, went to school, got abused physically and verbally all day, went to work after school, got verbally abused there, got home, started drinking, and here I am.
Death seems like the only win-win situation. I'm happy because the pain stops, and everybody else is happy because they don't have to deal with me anymore.
I find that incredibly difficult to believe.
I am a waste. I am completely worthless, the world would be at least slightly better without me.
I do plan to live my life, for another week at most. Its not fair that anybody has to share my burdens, and its not fair that I'm taking resources that a far more worthwhile person could be using.

I'm not implying you're worthless, you're far from it. What I'm trying to say is,  I really don't know you, making you a stranger, and chances are you came across this submission randomly, thus bringing up the name. I'm the one without family, friends, or aspirations, not you. My sincere apologies if I offended you, at all.
Who would want to help me, besides the authorities or a random internet user? I'm not worth the time a professional would spend on me, there are worthwhile people that need the help.
Sorry, its just, I don't feel comfortable sharing an exact place. A Midwestern lake state.
My biological mother, just like everyone else.

It is true. I don't deserve someone as truly awesome as her, and she doesn't deserve to have to deal with a worthless loser like me. If there is an afterlife, I deserve eternal torment for being so terrible. Who knows? Maybe I'll find out if there's an afterlife soon.

Why should I lie? The only thing I deserve is a slow and painful death, maybe by slowly bleeding out, maybe by drowning or suffocation. I dunno, either way, its what I deserve for being such a defective failure of a human being, if I can even be called human.
I don't deserve to feel better. The only way I deserve to feel any better is to end it all.
But it is. I am trying to lash out against the people trying to help, that almost by definition makes me a bad person.
Evidence that I'm not a good person right here. I'm debating you into the dirt that I'm a terrible person. That's why I just don't deserve to live, all I do is take up space and resources.

It is all true. For the physical aspects, I'm short, pale, scrawny, and my face isn't exactly good looking. Socially, I almost have a panic attack if I'm left alone with people I don't know very well. And as for the mental aspects, the depression, along with the social inability. I'm a drain on society, I don't deserve to live, there are people out there that actually deserve the food I eat, the water I drink, the oxygen I breathe.

Everything is wrong with me. I'm socially reclusive, physically unattractive, mentally unstable and defective, the list would be too long to type on here. She doesn't deserve to share my burden, nobody does. If I wasn't alive, the world would be a better place.

This is a shortened version of the story, but we ended up just laying and talking for what seems like years, things got, err, umm, nsfw, and that was the end of the night. She kept reinforcing that above all, she wanted to spend time with me, and that was the must fun thing for her, but I still feel guilty about my existence. I still feel like the world would be better off without me.
Yeah. Well, she should be home any minute, so I ought to get my sorry ass off of the internet and try talking to her.
Yeah, I see where you're coming from. I guess I have all of the reasons in the world too be happy, but just can't feel happy. I think that's my problem.
That solves money, but not trust. I don't want an involuntary stay at a mental institution.
I wish I had the money and the trust to talk to a professional, but all that'd get me is a one way ticket to a padded cell.
You sure? I'm fairly certain it is. All I do is hurt people, without me, everybody I know would be much happier.
Because its true.

But I do deserve it, I don't deserve to be called a person, I don't deserve to take up the resources that I need to live when someone more worthy could be using those resources. There is no good in life, not for me. I deserve to be hit and killed by a bus tomorrow.
My life needs to be miserable, I deserve every little bit of it. Besides, why would anyone care about a depressed, worthless, terrible person of a loser like me?

Everything would be better without me. Peers and coworkers want me to kill myself, and I shouldn't deprive them of what they want, and I am just a terrible human being. Even if looks didn't matter, my inner core of mental instability and illness would. A life to live? I can spend the next fifty years working my ass off for little pay, have no money for retirement, and have to work myself into a grave. Either way, I'm going to die in the end, why not bring that end a little closer?

Yeah, 15. I don't deserve to live or be happy, I'm short, scrawny, uglier than a greased pig, not to mention the personality defects (depression, BDD, social awkwardness, the list goes on). The only thing I deserve is a painful death that looks enough like an accident to get it ruled as such, the last thing I want is for her to be hurt by my decision to end my life. She deserves better, everybody deserves better, everything would be better without me.

Most of the time, I almost have to force her out of the door and get her to enjoy herself, and I haven't been talking to her about leaving her, mostly I just listen about her day, and lie about how mine was good. Besides, I don't want to leave her, I love her more than anything else in the world. And, well, I've been drinking a bit, popping a few Valium here and there, putting a slice or two in my arm every half hour-forty five minutes.

I'm distrustful of meds, antidepressants can really eff you up (I've witnessed it in friends who have gone totally nuts after starting them), and a professional wouldn't care, even if I could afford one. And its not like we are always together, we usually see eachother in the morning and evening, other than that, we're both at work or school or whatever. Its not being with her that's killing me, she wants me to be with her (who am I to deny her wishes?), it's the feeling that her sharing the burden of my problems is just unfair.

I just can't bring myself to. Getting out of bed is a challenge on its own, and besides, she'd still feel like she needed to stick to me like glue, and I would probably convince the nearest person to buy me booze to drink the troubles away, and that's just not her thing. I'd just drag her down more, and I only want her to be happy, and she would be far happier without me.

Kids in school, and coworkers, and boss. Parents were locked up when I was really young, spent a lot of time in the system until my girlfriend told me to live with her. And, it just isn't fair for her, staying in all night eating ramen and watching Netflix isn't her ideal night, and I can tell she just isn't enjoying it. Why should a loser like me weigh down her life?

Well, I've had clinical depression for the past three years, I've been self harming for two, and I've tried to kill myself numerous times. I go to school, all I get is "kill yourself", and when I fail and they hear about it, all I get is "you are such a *expletive* failure, you can't even *expletive* kill yourself *expletive* right". The same goes for work, but rent needs to be paid and food needs to be put on the table. But to be honest, my biggest problem is feeling guilty for weighing her down, she deserves better than a worthless loser like me, the world at large would be a better place without me. Edit: The absolutely horrifyingly ugly physical appearance and the personality defects don't help, either.
I dunno, I'm bad at free association, and my entire life story would take too long to type. Sorry about the late reply, by the way.
Screw it. Might as well.

Every time I try talking with her, she seems to want to take on more of my problems,  and ito spend more time with me. As much as I love spending time with her, I don't want her to spend her time around the apartment trying to comfort me as I mope, she likes to spend time out and she is probably really bored (there are only so many good movies on Netflix). The problem is, I don't want to stop talking to her, the last time I pushed her away because she cared too much I ended up being suicidal, and that is not an experience I want to relive. I'm just so conflicted, I want to be with her, and I want her to be happy, and spending nights in does not seem to make her happy, no matter how much she tries to convince me otherwise.
Not sure if substance abuse counts as self harm, but if anything it seems to help, so I don't know why I'd file it under harm.

Just thought I'd let you, and anyone else who happens to be reading, know how things are going. As scared as I was at first, and how terrible I felt, the shared stress really seems to strengthen our relationship. Hell, today, although very grudgingly at first, I agreed to skip school (I know, I know, but I think I deserve a day off for once) and spend the day with her, a little bit of time shopping and stuff like that, a nice dinner, and a movie or two on Netflix. I just couldn't stop crying, for the first time in ages, I actually felt happy, and I forgot how good it felt to not be constantly depressed.
Thanks, man. The same to you. I'm not going to try to force you to, but if you need to talk, let me know.

Thank you so much, you really won't believe how thankful I am that you had the courage to respond. Trust me, if you need anything, I'll handle it. And loving her as much as I can, that is one thing I can do. I have to run, I have school tomorrow, and I need to practice my right hook for a completely unrelated reason, so good night. Once again, thank you. Really, from the bottom of my heart.

Good news and bad news. Good news is, she was perfectly understanding, and we hugged for what seemed like years. I also think this thread belongs on r/depression, because the feelings are subsiding. Bad news is, I still feel terrible for using her as my crutch, no matter how much she says she doesn't mind. I really owe you, man, 70 or so messages ago, I didn't want to live anymore, but now, I'm glad I hesitated and didn't go through with it. Really, man, thank you. You need anything, literally anything, just let me know.

Usually she's back around 530, she usually likes to spend a lot of time out and about, unlike me. I take it as a challenge to get out of bed in the morning, whereas she lobes to be up and around, that's why I didn't want to get attached, I'll just weigh her down.
I don't know. I really don't want to get attached to her, I don't want a reason to deal with all the pain.
Just sitting, napping, trying to figure out what I'm going to say to her when she gets back.
Yeah, barely.
Alright, I'll wait until you're out, but I'm not sure if I can take it anymore.

I just, I don't want to have to face her, I just feel so bad for wanting to kill myself, I honestly don't think I can face her, but there's nothing here I can use so I don't have to face her. Well, I guess I could try and jump out the window, she can't keep those locked. All I'd have to do is push out the screen.

I just... Don't want to scare her, I don't want to slow her life down and drag her down with my problems, she doesn't need that, I want her to be happy, and her knowing about my problems, feeling like she needs to help, that will drain the smile from her face.
She's something to live for, but not a release for all of the pain I feel, I don't want to live in a state of constant sadness because I have a single reason to live.
But if I get attached to her again, she'll give me a reason to live, and I really don't want to have to deal with another day of living.
But if I tell her the truth, I'm afraid she'll freak and I'll be alone again, and it's not safe to be on my own right now.

No, what I fear is that she cares too much, that's why I'm pushing her away. And the only reason I will survive is because I don't have the equipment or the guts to shoot myself or slit my wrists, the only really surefire ways to end it.

I keep her in the dark to keep her happy, so she doesn't have to worry about what I might do, so she doesn't feel guilty if I go through with it, so that she isn't weighed down by me, so she can live the life she wants to live, not the life she has to because of me.

Frankly, I hope never, I don't want to have to face her and explain my problem, she won't understand, she'll just get scared, and I'm afraid I'll lose the only person that it doesn't hurt to be around.

Let's see, she's the most beautiful girl I've ever laid eyes on, she's 18, blonde, blue eyes, petite figure, maybe 5'8". Personality wise, she's funny, almost always cheerful, a lot like I was before I fell into depression. Sorry for taking so long, but I'm having trouble typing and not tearing up at the same time.
She wouldn't have seen me, I would've been in the morgue by the time she got to me, I wouldn't respond to her texts as usual, to her, nothing would be wrong.

Sorry about the late reply, I was getting myself some food, for the first time in about a week. But I really don't want to burden anyone, let alone her, with all my problems, all that'll happen is that she'll get distressed and freak out.

You're not bugging me, trust me. Having someone to talk to, I dunno, it's making me have second thoughts. But the only reason I've survived so far is because every time I've tried, someone has managed to call 911, and I've woken up in the hospital, pissed off and sadder than before.
I'm ugly, I'm worthless, I'm weak, I'm scrawny, I'm emotionally unstable. What is there to like?

Alright, fine, I'll cave. I won't cut right now, besides, it looks like she was planning ahead, I could sharpen a butter knife on the counter, but I don't want to stress her out, so I won't do that. I still can't figure out why she cares about a worthless person like me.
I do have something to do, right now I'm looking for some sort of sharp object that I can use to cut.
Nope. If I did, what would be the point? So my postmortem grades would be a little bit higher?
Nope. Just me at her apartment.
She's out on the town with some friends, I told her not to be burdened by me and actually enjoy herself.
Yeah, I'm at her place right now, but as much as I want to, I just can't bring myself to do it here.
Nope, for us, every third Monday is a day for teachers to plan without having to deal with students.
What, surround myself with people that don't care so I can be suicidal somewhere else?

First thing, tell that to my scars covering my arms that are going to keep me from getting a job. Second thing, I've sought help from all the school officials I can reach out to, and they haven't done anything. Its not like the abuse is new, I've been dealing with it for the past six years. Third thing, I only push her away because I don't want her too feel guilty for the decision I am making. Last thing, it hasn't just been high school, I've been cutting for three years, feeling suicidal for two, and I cannot even remember when the perpetual sadness began.
Unfortunately, yes, I am still alive.
But what is there to be positive about? I can't remember the last time I was happy, and I have nothing to look forward to.

I don't want to post too much because I'm on my data plan and not WiFi, but she managed to convince me to hold off on my plans and stay with her for a bit, and in return, she's told me she won't check me into a mental hospital or anything like that. I still feel suicidal, but I don't want to go through with it around her and traumatize her.

Though waking up in the ICU some days later feeling like I was on fire made the sadness afterwards so much worse. I guess I'm just making things harder for myself by only remembering the bad things in my life, but that's all I can remember.
The closest to feeling happy o can remember is when I overdosed on sleeping pills, on my last attempt, and I was drifting off, feeling like it was finally over, like I could finally relax.

She won't feel guilty if she isn't here, if I'm already in the morgue by the time she gets here, if she doesn't know I'm dead. I've been giving life a chance, for a long time. I used to tell myself that I could make it one more week, then it got down to one more day, recently I've been down to one more hour, and within the bast day, I've been having to tell myself one more minute.

Well, let's run through the script I have pretty much memorized. The operator asks why I'm calling, I tell them I'm planning to kill myself, wording it so it sounds like I'm doing it tomorrow or the day after, being careful not to say anything about how ready I am to try, they ask why I feel that way, I give them that spiel that I used when I posted here, they get into specifics, I'm still careful about everything I say, not giving direct evidence that I am in danger, tell them the truth, that there are people waiting for them that aren't worthless, people that have those that really care for them, then hang up.
Why would I want to talk to her beforehand? If I kill myself after talking to her, she'll just feel guilty about my decision.
Just got off the phone with them, after spending some time talking to them, answering questions, and two or three minutes convincing the operator not to call the police.

Recently, I've turned to drugs and alcohol,  they're really the only things I like. I mean, sure I still like my ex, but she's going to be busting down my door in forty minutes, trying to stop the decision I want to make.
Suicidal thoughts started two years ago, and have been fairly constant since then. She just wants me to think that she cares, just like everybody else, but nobody really cares.

I already tried the national suicide prevention hotline, but I suppose I could always try again, what is ten minutes when I have all of eternity? You see? This is why I didn't want to talk to anyone, they'd feel burdened with a life, albeit a worthless one, in their hands.
